benchmarks.note: Saved query 'YSE Magnitude-Limited Sample (min mag < 18.6)' on the personal dashboard (issue #204). Gating tier: test_mag_limited_query_regression seeds the dataset below and scales budgets linearly when YSE_PERF_MAG_LIMITED_TRANSIENTS is larger; each SELECT is capped server-side at the SQL budget. baseline_ms is compared unscaled against the gating tier (300 x 10) and stays null until a CI run of the gating tier has printed its timings (the test now logs '<key>: <ms> ms'); paste those in to enable the 2x regression check. full_tier_reference_ms is the 3000 x 20 measurement from record_perf_benchmark (non-gating); the command warns when a full-tier run exceeds regression_factor times it.

full_tier.baseline_source: GitHub Actions run 36517297730 (first full-tier record_perf_benchmark after PR #206): 188.8 / 390.5 / 203.0 ms, rounded up
full_tier.note: Reference for entries.*.full_tier_reference_ms. Scaled linearly like max_ms when YSE_PERF_MAG_LIMITED_TRANSIENTS is above 3000.

mag_limited_sample_sql.note: Raw SQL via the dashboard cursor path, also the max_execution_time cap. Production budget is 60 s at ~300x this volume; a good plan runs this in well under a second, a per-candidate-row dependent-subquery plan takes tens of seconds.

personal_dashboard_mag_limited_cold.note: /personaldashboard/section/<id>/ with empty result cache: SQL + Transient table build + render.

personal_dashboard_mag_limited_warm.note: Same fragment with the SQL result cached (1 h TTL in the view); table build + render only.
